description: A Minecraft 26.2 Fabric mod that fixes the rendering bug introduced in Minecraft 26.2 (MC-308593), where nearly all animated blocks render incorrectly, with water turning completely invisible as the most noticeable issue. This mod is an AI-assisted community fix.

mods.name: MC-308593 Fix
mods.description: Workaround for animated texture rendering bug (MC-308593) on older Intel GPUs

releases.notes:
Fabric mod workaround for MC-308593 (invisible water / black lava/fire on older Intel GPUs) in Minecraft 26.2.

Usage: download the jar below and place it in `.minecraft/mods/`.

Requires Fabric Loader 0.19.3+ and Java 25.
